fix: Store the handlers as Rc<[NotificationHandler]> so the per-dispatch snapshot is a refcount bump, not a Vec allocation: change ListenerNode.handlers to RefCell<Rc<[NotificationHandler]>> (initialise with Rc::from([])), and keep the borrow released before the callbacks run: let handlers = current.handlers.borrow().clone(); for handler in handlers.iter() { ... }. The Rc clone is taken while the RefCell borrow is held only for the clone, so re-entrant rebuilds still cannot hit a live borrow_mut during a callback.

Convert once outside the retained builder closure, in listen(): let handlers: Rc<[NotificationHandler]> = handlers.into(); before Widget::retained_builder. Then the per-build assignment becomes *node.handlers.borrow_mut() = handlers.clone(); (an Rc clone, no Vec clone per build). Pairs with the dispatch change on line 73, which uses the same Rc<[NotificationHandler]> field type.
